script: Pluto takes 248 Earth years to orbit the Sun. It has not completed a single orbit since it was discovered in 1930. It will not finish its first one until the year 2178. Pluto was called a planet for 76 years. In 2006, astronomers reclassified it as a dwarf planet. Follow WonderBytes for more facts that sound fake but are true.
